sources.games: 290 league games since 7.40 (7.41 alone had under 300) (data/heroes/item_stats), win 59.3%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py sniper.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Hydra's Breath, Hurricane Pike.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Sniper players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 29% of 24 games against them (5% otherwise), won 57% against 41%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Sniper players against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 33% of 24 games against them (7% otherwise), won 75% against 44%.

rules.name: Hydra's Breath

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: upgrade your Dragon Lance into {item}, not Hurricane Pike; 30% of your attacks also hit up to 3 more enemies and poison them
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: Dragon Lance збирайте в {item}, а не в Hurricane Pike; 30 % атак б'ють ще до 3 ворогів поруч і отруюють їх

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Hydra's Breath (Dragon Lance + Specialist's Array + Orb of Venom): 30% of ranged attacks also fire at up to 3 nearby enemies, and Miasma poisons each one hit for 2.5% of max HP per second. High-rank Snipers against illusion heroes: 34% of 38 games against them (16% otherwise), won 85% against 72%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 84% (2), magic_wand 48% (3), power_treads 98% (6), mask_of_madness 49% (12), maelstrom 79% (14), dragon_lance 87% (18), specialists_array 22% (19), mjollnir 72% (20), force_staff 42% (23), hydras_breath 21% (23), hurricane_pike 40% (24), aghanims_shard 23% (25), lesser_crit 53% (26), greater_crit 26% (29).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 25:00 18000 (12 games, 91.7%), 30:00 17500 (56 games, 85.7%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold. The 25:00 line rests on 12 games and lies above the 30:00 one, so only 30:00 is used.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

skills.basis: 290 games: maxed sniper_shrapnel > sniper_headshot > sniper_take_aim 136 (win 58.1%), sniper_headshot > sniper_take_aim > sniper_shrapnel 61 (win 63.9%), sniper_headshot > sniper_shrapnel > sniper_take_aim 43 (win 69.8%); talents 10: Headshot Damage 263/290 (59.3%), Take Aim Passive Attack Range 27/290 (59.3%); 15: Attack Speed During Take Aim 158/254 (63.3%), Assassinate Damage 96/254 (63.5%); 20: Take Aim Duration 103/115 (73.8%), Shrapnel Damage 12/115 (58.3%); 25: Max Headshot Knockback Distance 9/13 (88.9%), Shrapnel Charge Restore Time 4/13 (75.0%).
